text: no. you edited the wrong file space. we do not use the hmsc/ dir at all, its stale. it should be deleted to stop exactly what just happened to  you. if the existing props are importing from there, lets fix that
resolution: cart/hmsc/ is dissolved per the ruling. Its live library (design.ts, world/, render3d/, state/, commands/, events/, gameplay/, input/, npc/, render/, ui/, tools/, labs scenes) moved wholesale into cart/hmsc-int/ preserving structure, so every internal import kept working; the dead cart shell became cart/hmsc-int/gameShell.tsx (kept because rjit pack bundles it as the game package script entry); cart.json and stale docs deleted — there is no cart/hmsc directory anymore and no bootable hmsc cart. All 105 stale imports inside hmsc-int rewritten to local paths; the six consumer carts (pathing_lab, vehicle_lab, combat_lab, effect_fills, hmsc_scale_lab, hmsc_massive_map_lab) plus hmsc-int-old re-pointed to ../hmsc-int/; cli pack.ts, scripts/hmsc-check, zig comment references, and 549 docs/game path references updated; tools/rjit.js rebundled. Zero references to cart/hmsc remain repo-wide. The new-props work from req_0588 rode along into the moved files. Verified by bundling all 8 affected cart entries through the real cart bundler (all OK) and running the kinds/props + build suites (green).
